database_requests.label:
-- Retrieve saved availability and planning shifts
SELECT s.*, a.available, a.lateFlag
FROM Shift s LEFT JOIN StaffAvailability a
ON a.shiftID = s.shiftID AND a.staffID = :staffId
WHERE s.date >= :windowStart
AND s.date < :windowEnd;

-- Save this shift's availability and late flag
INSERT INTO StaffAvailability
(staffID, shiftID, available, lateFlag)
VALUES (:staffId, :shiftId, :available, :lateFlag)
ON CONFLICT (staffID, shiftID) DO UPDATE
SET available = EXCLUDED.available,
lateFlag = EXCLUDED.lateFlag;
guards: each prepared shift record

VALUES (:actor, :time, :previous, :new, :reason);

-- Find eligible ambulances for this shift and slot
SELECT a.ambulanceNumber
FROM Ambulance a JOIN AmbulanceAvailability u
  ON u.ambulanceNumber = a.ambulanceNumber
WHERE a.activeStatus = 'active' AND u.shiftID = :shiftId
  AND u.available = TRUE AND NOT EXISTS
  (SELECT 1 FROM RosterSlot r
   WHERE r.ambulanceNumber = a.ambulanceNumber
     AND r.shiftID = :shiftId
     AND (:slotId IS NULL OR r.slotID <> :slotId));
guards: roster status is draft
allocation requested and no invalid-ambulance warning
